description: Change one existing item in an owned Library List (text, completed, color, notes, priority, dueDate), for example to check it off. Changes only the fields named in updateFields. Use the listId and expectedVersion from the latest library_list_get. On library_version_mismatch, read the list again and reconsider the change; never retry blindly. Library Lists only, not trip checklists.

expectedVersion.description: Opaque version from the latest library_list_get or Library List tool result.

listId.description: Library List ID from library_lists_search or library_list_get.

updateFields.description: The fields the user asked to change. Only these keys of updates are applied. To clear a nullable field, name it here and set it to an empty string, only when the user asks to clear it.

updates.description: New values for the fields named in updateFields.

name: library_list_item_update
title: Update Library List Item
